summary: A playable prototype with functional AI laser tag battles, HUD, and hills, but hindered by severe bloom/overexposure, blocky low-poly buildings that lack San Francisco detail, framerate drops (15 FPS), and sticky building collisions that trap the player car for the second half of the test drive.

top_issues.issue: Car gets stuck against building walls with no sliding or auto-recovery
top_issues.evidence: From 00:08 to 00:19 (and Screenshots 3-5), after turning left into a building corner, the car remains wedged at ~0-3 MPH despite 'w', 'w+d', and 'w+Shift' inputs.
top_issues.fix_hint: Implement smooth wall-sliding collision response (project velocity along wall normal) and widen street corridors so turns don't immediately hit buildings.

top_issues.issue: Extreme bloom and overexposure wash out the road, crosswalks, and car body
top_issues.evidence: Screenshot 1 and video 00:00-00:04 show glowing white crosswalks and car body blooming so brightly that street details and car contours disappear.
top_issues.fix_hint: Significantly raise the bloom threshold so only lasers and emissive lights glow, not white paint or car surfaces, and reduce directional light intensity.

top_issues.issue: City looks like generic untextured procedural boxes rather than realistic San Francisco streets
top_issues.evidence: Screenshots 1-5 compared to real SF reference photos: streets are pale grey untextured planes without curbs or sidewalks, and lacks palm/street trees, overhead trolley wires, and detailed Victorian/brick facades.
top_issues.fix_hint: Add darker asphalt road textures with lane markings, raised sidewalks with curbs, street trees/palms along sidewalks, overhead wires, and richer building facade details.

top_issues.issue: Vehicle model is very boxy and lacks Jaguar I-PACE SUV curves and Waymo branding
top_issues.evidence: Close-up of player car in Screenshots 1-5 shows a blocky white rectangle with a glowing cyan cylinder, missing the sloped coupe roofline, wheel arches, and side/rear details.
top_issues.fix_hint: Refine the car mesh to have a sloped SUV roofline, visible dark windows, distinct wheel arches, black sensor pods on fenders, and a clearer non-blown-out lidar dome.

top_issues.issue: Low framerate during driving and strange dithered shadow artifacts behind the car
top_issues.evidence: Telemetry reports 15-17 FPS during movement steps; Screenshot 1 and 2 show a coarse checkerboard/grid shadow artifact trailing behind the player car.
top_issues.fix_hint: Optimize geometry/draw calls (merge static city meshes or use instancing) to hit 60 FPS, and fix shadow map bias/resolution around the player vehicle.
